simple.meaning: חֲדַד (Chădad) is a Hebrew word meaning “Chadad , an Ishmaelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חֲדַד (H2301) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 25:15, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲדַד (H2301) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חֲדַד (H2301) before moving outward to related references.
